creator: Alexander Terp
description: 2026-10-04: a codex exec run inside a Codex pane inherits MUSTER_PANE and reports its own session id through the SessionStart hook; a command wake then goes to a session that has ended. Since 4d9eeba1 a wake nobody takes within 5 s is typed instead and the id forgotten, so nothing is lost, but the first wake is wasted. Measure whether the hook input tells the two apart.
title: codex queue: tell a nested codex exec's SessionStart from the interactive session's
